title: A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.06597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates of linear peeling-ballooning stability now run in milliseconds, but they are mostly deployed as point estimators: they do not say how wrong they may be, or when a query lies outside what they were trained on. For a fusion company designing a new device, every equilibrium of interest is outside the training data of existing surrogates, so this is the case that matters. We describe a model-agnostic trust layer for stability surrogates, made of conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms that route doubtful cases to the physics code, and recalibration from a few simulations of a new design, and we test it with pre-registered hypotheses. On a large public dataset of JET-like equilibria with ideal-MHD growth rates, the error bars hold their nominal coverage in distribution and fall short under a shift in plasma shape; a few dozen simulations of the new shape, or routing the cases the alarms flag, restore it. translated_title: 面向快速台基稳定性代理模型的信任层：校准误差棒、分布外告警与少样本重校准
translated_abstract: 线性剥离-气球模稳定性的机器学习代理模型如今可在毫秒级运行，但它们大多以点估计器的形式被部署：既不说明自身可能有多大误差，也不告知查询是否超出了训练数据的范围。对于一家正在设计新装置的核聚变公司而言，所有感兴趣的平衡态都处于现有代理模型的训练数据之外，因此这才是真正重要的场景。我们提出了一种与模型无关的稳定性代理模型信任层，由共形误差棒、将可疑案例路由至物理代码的分布外告警，以及基于少量新设计模拟进行重校准三部分组成，并通过预注册假设对其进行了检验。在一个包含JET类平衡态及理想MHD增长率的大型公开数据集上，误差棒在分布内保持了名义覆盖率，但在等离子体形状发生偏移时覆盖率有所下降；通过对新形状进行几十次模拟，或将告警标记的案例路由至物理代码，均可恢复该覆盖率。
tldr: 提出了一种与模型无关的核聚变台基稳定性代理模型信任层，通过共形误差棒、分布外告警和少样本重校准，即使在等离子体形状偏移导致查询超出训练数据时也能提供可信的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: A model-agnostic trust layer for fusion pedestal-stability machine-learning surrogates that combines conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms routing doubtful cases to physics codes, and few-shot recalibration, delivering calibrated uncertainty estimates even when plasma-shape shifts place queries outside the training distribution.
